{{Conjecture|legends}}
On the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tokmia/Legends|Tokmia]], a '''cargo cult''' developed among the primitive [[Oku]] [[Species/Legends|species]] following the cessation of [[Figg Excavations/Legends|Figg Excavations]]' [[Mining/Legends|mining]] efforts there. During the ongoing excavating of Tokmia's [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits, Figg employees often gave handouts to the Oku natives with each operation. Once the miners departed the planet, the Oku burned huge [[Fire/Legends|fires]] to resemble landing lights in belief that the [[Magic/Legends|magical]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of the offworlders would someday return.

{{Deity-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Oku cargo cult closely resembles the real-world phenomenon of [[Wikipedia:Cargo cult|cargo cults]], particularly that which developed among primitive Pacific islanders post-World War II. [[Wikipedia:Melanesians|Melanesians]], for example, having witnessed the massive wartime influx of war materiel from both American and Japanese forces, lit signal fires after the end of the war to illuminate abandoned runways, believing they could compel the return of the foreigners' manufactured goods.
